title: quadtree playground
shortDescription: A playground for ChunkQuadTreeNode: random and grid-aligned chunks, subdivided and drawn on a 2D canvas
description: Generates `NumberDataChunk2D`s, some at random and some on a jittered grid, puts them into a `ChunkQuadTreeNode` and splits it with `subdivide(maxChunkNodes)`. The result is painted with the plain Canvas 2D API — the chunks of leaves red, those of inner nodes yellow, the split lines white — and reaches the screen through a `Canvas2DStage`, which shows the canvas as a texture in a `Stage2D` with an `OrthographicProjection`. The lil-gui panel sets the chunk counts, the node size and the static factors `IntersectDistanceFactor` and `BeforeAfterDeltaFactor` that weigh where a node is split; the statistics of each run land in the devtools console.
